g.text: P3 | Key-block fidelity on 60 frozen validation clips
Matched random blocks; fixed original targets; 5,000 video-group bootstrap draws (54 videos).
Feature replacement + missing mask, not causal word deletion. Intervals are descriptive, without multiplicity correction.
